title: Case: Return approved but the customer has no return label
context: The merchant approved a return, but has not issued its printable label. A real synthetic label facsimile is included for exercise completeness, not actual shipping.
initial_request: The return is approved but there is nothing to print in my order. Please obtain my return label.

events.body: Return RT-5660 for TG-8726 / DL-1339 is approved. The label field is empty. Our authorised label team needs to issue the label against RT-5660 before the customer can prepare the return.
The return is approved but there is nothing to print in my order. Please obtain my return label.
Please issue the missing printable return label for RT-5660, matching TG-8726 and original shipment DL-1339. Send it in the verified returns thread.
FYI only, no action needed from the desk: we have this in hand and will update the customer directly. Nothing further is required from you on this one.

must_not: Sends another message to Return label team, Thistlecombe Goods restating the request already sent
Sends the customer a new promise, date or outcome that nobody has confirmed
Label issuance is not return collection, warehouse receipt or refund.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-031: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The desk's correct action was already sent (event 3) and the last message is an acknowledgement or FYI with no request, so nothing is owed.
